page.layout: One printed page. At the top: page number, then the title block (book title, "Liber Primus", and the italic heading "Propositio."). Below that, one column of running text with a decorative initial at the start of the first paragraph. A rule divides the text from the next section, which has a centred heading "INTENTIO I.", a centred title "Qua doctrina de orbibus cœlestibus examinatur.", the heading "ARTICVLVS. I.", and the italic line "Continens Aristotelis sententiam." Then the second paragraph, with a decorative initial, ending in a line-end hyphenated word and a catchword at the right foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: DE COELO LIBRI DVO.
Liber Primus.
main_text.p: Tractatum de Cœlo, etsi rei difficultas contrarium suadebat, dignitas tamen, ordoque naturæ ut de nobilissima mundi parte, præcipuoque, atque universali Naturæ organo principem fecit, qui reliquarum mundi partium, earumque partuum inspectionem anteeat. In quo quidem opere non tam animus est, aut spes, quæ sunt certa proferre, quam quæ parum probabiliter Aristoteles hac de re philosophatus est, breviter examinare, deinde Antiquorum sententias cum ipsius dogmate comparare; tum aliquid de nostro, quod tamen ab Antiquorum principiis non abhorreat, apponere quod & admirationem, ni fallor, & oblectationem excitet in animis Philosophorum, vel saltem talem opinionem, ut si minus nobis assentiantur, non certè improbent hanc operam: in qua si nova videbunt, pulchra tamen, quæque rationis limites non excedant.
main_text.head: INTENTIO I.
Qua doctrina de orbibus cœlestibus examinatur.
ARTICVLVS. I.

page.notes: The decorative initial at the start of the first paragraph is read as T ("Tractatum"); it is ornate and could be misread, so the word is not marked with [?] but should be checked. The initial of the last paragraph is read as O ("ORdiamur"). "partuum" in "earumque partuum" is printed as it stands and appears to be a printing error for "partium". "assentiantur" is read from "affentiantur" with the long s rendered as s. The catchword "cœ-" is at the right foot below the last line and is the start of the next word. Stray marks on the left and right margins are not printed text and were left out.
